title.narrative: n 2024, UNICEF India further enhanced its leadership and expertise in research, evaluation, data, and knowledge management. The office prioritized a total of 12 evidence activities through a stronger planning and quality assurance process. UNICEF partnered with NITI Aayog, MoSPI, MoWCD, select state governments, academia, donors and CSOs to strengthen M&E and data systems, and initiated strategic conversations with private-sector. Partners were also convened through the second annual ‘Evidence for Children Roundtable&39;, and the ongoing &39;Evaluation Capacity Development&39; Consortium.
